calculation.description: 60-day rolling correlation of asset daily returns with SPX returns (cross-asset beta/regime factor). High values = high beta to US equities.

validation.regime_notes: Validated on 15-instrument tradable cross-asset universe (equity indices, commodities, crypto, yields). Regime split: 2020-2021: ic=0.083 icir=0.260 n=497; 2022-2022: ic=-0.036 icir=-0.086 n=258; 2023-2024: ic=0.094 icir=0.258 n=516; 2025-2026: ic=0.031 icir=0.091 n=395
